channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi blasts Houthi ‘war crimes’; US warns on Saudi airports
item.description: Saudi Arabia calls Houthi attacks 'full-fledged war crimes' while the US warns of possible attacks on Saudi airports.

item.title: At least 4, including 3 children, killed in US elementary school shooting
item.description: Authorities have indicated that the shooter was killed by gunfire, though details remain scant about the attack.

item.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
item.description: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.

item.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
item.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

item.title: Hundreds of IDF investigations into killings still have no public outcome, BBC Verify finds
item.description: BBC Verify has identified 254 incidents from the past three years the Israeli military said it is reviewing after being accused of harm.

item.title: At the scene of a school roof collapse in Pakistan
item.description: At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed according to hospital officials, and more than a dozen were injured.
